Check the agreement of the best BLAST hits

Source: R/blast_hits.R
check_hits.Rd

For each query sequence, decides whether its best hits agree on the taxon (Check ID) and summarises all of its hits.

Check ID looks at the first check_n hits. Only the hits whose identity is within tolerance percentage points of the best identity among them are compared: a hit clearly less identical than the best one is most likely another taxon, not a competing identification. Coverage is not used here, so a good reference that covers only part of the query does not hide or create a disagreement.

  • "best ID": all the compared hits have the taxid of the first hit.

  • "check ID": some compared hit has another taxid or an unknown one (0 or empty, as in databases built without a taxid map), or the first hit is not among the most identical ones.

  • NA: no hits.

The other columns use all the hits of the sequence: N hits, N taxids (distinct known taxids), N hits same taxid as 1st and N taxids at best identity (distinct taxids among the hits within tolerance of the best identity of all hits).

Usage

check_hits(hits, check_n = 3L, tolerance = 0.5)

Arguments

hits

Data frame with one row per hit and the columns query, rank, identity and staxid.

check_n

Number of best hits used by Check ID.

tolerance

Identity difference (percentage points) under which two hits are considered tied.

Value

A tibble with query and the summary columns.

Examples

hits <- data.frame(
  query = "q1", rank = 1:3,
  identity = c(100, 99, 98.7), staxid = c("9606", "9598", "9597")
)
check_hits(hits)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 6
#>   query `Check ID` `N hits` `N taxids` `N hits same taxid as 1st`
#>   <chr> <chr>         <int>      <int>                      <int>
#> 1 q1    best ID           3          3                          1
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: `N taxids at best identity` <int>
